figure.p: Photo walk from Kichijoji station, ending at a café

svg.aria-label: Map of the walk: from Kichijoji Station's park exit down to the east end of Inokashira Pond, once around the pond to Nanai Bridge, then up Nanaibashi-dori to the café. About 2.0 km.

ol.li: A café on Nanaibashi-doriCoffee and comparing shots
